from datetime import timedelta, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from backend.app.api.v1.deps import get_db_session, get_current_active_user
from backend.app.core.config import settings
from backend.app.core.security import (
    create_access_token,
    create_refresh_token,
    verify_password,
    get_password_hash,
    verify_refresh_token,
)
from backend.app.core.telemetry import telemetry_log
from backend.app.db import crud, schemas, models

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/register", response_model=schemas.UserRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
@telemetry_log
async def register_user(
    user_in: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session)
) -> Any:
    """
    Register a new user.
    """
    user = crud.get_user_by_email(db, email=user_in.email)
    if user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="The user with this email already exists in the system.",
        )
    user_in.password = get_password_hash(user_in.password)
    user = crud.create_user(db=db, user=user_in)
    return user


@router.post("/login", response_model=schemas.Token)
@telemetry_log
async def login_for_access_token(
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session)
) -> Any:
    """
    OAuth2 compatible token login, get an access token for future requests.
    """
    user = crud.get_user_by_email(db, email=form_data.username)
    if not user or not verify_password(form_data.password, user.hashed_password):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect email or password",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    if not user.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Inactive user")

    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    access_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": str(user.id), "scopes": form_data.scopes},
        expires_delta=access_token_expires,
    )
    refresh_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    refresh_token = create_refresh_token(
        data={"sub": str(user.id)},
        expires_delta=refresh_token_expires,
    )

    # Store refresh token in DB with actual datetime
    expires_at = datetime.utcnow() + refresh_token_expires
    crud.create_refresh_token(db, user_id=user.id, token=refresh_token, expires_at=expires_at)

    return {
        "access_token": access_token,
        "refresh_token": refresh_token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
    }


@router.post("/refresh-token", response_model=schemas.Token)
@telemetry_log
async def refresh_access_token(
    refresh_token_str: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session)
) -> Any:
    """
    Refresh access token using a valid refresh token.
    """
    try:
        payload = verify_refresh_token(refresh_token_str)
        user_id = payload["sub"]
    except HTTPException as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid or expired refresh token") from e

    db_refresh_token = crud.get_refresh_token(db, user_id=user_id, token=refresh_token_str)

    if not db_refresh_token or db_refresh_token.is_revoked or db_refresh_token.expires_at < datetime.utcnow():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid or expired refresh token")

    user = crud.get_user(db, user_id=user_id)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="User not found")
    if not user.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Inactive user")

    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    new_access_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": str(user.id), "scopes": ["me"]},  # TODO: Get actual scopes from user roles
        expires_delta=access_token_expires,
    )

    return {
        "access_token": new_access_token,
        "refresh_token": refresh_token_str,  # Return the same refresh token
        "token_type": "bearer",
    }


@router.post("/logout", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
@telemetry_log
async def logout_user(
    refresh_token_str: str,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> Any:
    """
    Revoke a refresh token, effectively logging out the user.
    """
    db_refresh_token = crud.get_refresh_token(db, user_id=current_user.id, token=refresh_token_str)

    if not db_refresh_token:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Refresh token not found for this user.")

    if db_refresh_token.is_revoked:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Refresh token already revoked.")

    crud.revoke_refresh_token(db, db_refresh_token)
    return

    item_id: UUID,
    item_in: schemas.InventoryItemUpdate,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> Any:
    """
    Update an existing inventory item.
    Requires authentication and ownership or admin role.

from typing import Generator
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
from jose import jwt
from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from backend.app.db.database import SessionLocal
from backend.app.db import crud, models, schemas
from backend.app.core.config import settings
from backend.app.core.security import verify_access_token
from backend.app.core.logging import logger

reusable_oauth2 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(
    tokenUrl=f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/login",
    scopes={"me": "Read information about the current user.", "admin": "Admin privileges."},
)


def get_db_session() -> Generator:
    """
    Dependency to get a database session.
    """
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


def get_current_user(db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), token: str = Depends(reusable_oauth2)) -> models.User:
    """
    Dependency to get the current user from the JWT token.
    """
    try:
        payload = verify_access_token(token)
        token_data = schemas.TokenPayload(**payload)
        user_id = token_data.sub  # Access the 'sub' field from TokenPayload
    except (jwt.JWTError, ValidationError, Exception) as e:
        logger.warning(f"Invalid token or token payload: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Could not validate credentials",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    user = crud.get_user(db, user_id=user_id)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="User not found")
    return user


def get_current_active_user(current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> models.User:
    """
    Dependency to get the current active user.
    """
    if not current_user.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Inactive user")
    return current_user


def get_current_active_admin(current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user)) -> models.User:
    """
    Dependency to get the current active admin user.
    """
    if not current_user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="The user doesn't have enough privileges"
        )
    return current_user

from datetime import timedelta, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from backend.app.api.v1.deps import get_db_session, get_current_active_user
from backend.app.core.config import settings
from backend.app.core.security import (
    create_access_token,
    create_refresh_token,
    verify_password,
    get_password_hash,
    verify_refresh_token,
)
from backend.app.core.telemetry import telemetry_log
from backend.app.db import crud, schemas, models

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/register", response_model=schemas.UserRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, summary="Register a new user")
@telemetry_log
async def register_user(
    user_in: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session)
) -> Any:
    """
    Registers a new user in the system.

    - **email**: User's email (must be unique).
    - **password**: User's password.
    - **full_name**: Optional full name of the user.
    """
    user = crud.get_user_by_email(db, email=user_in.email)
    if user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="The user with this email already exists in the system.",
        )
    # Hash the password before storing it
    user_in.password = get_password_hash(user_in.password)
    user = crud.create_user(db=db, user=user_in)
    return user


@router.post("/login", response_model=schemas.Token, summary="Login and get JWT tokens")
@telemetry_log
async def login_for_access_token(
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session)
) -> Any:
    """
    OAuth2 compatible token login, get an access token and a refresh token for future requests.

    - **username**: User's email.
    - **password**: User's password.
    - **scope**: Optional scopes for the token (e.g., "me", "admin").
    """
    user = crud.get_user_by_email(db, email=form_data.username)
    if not user or not verify_password(form_data.password, user.hashed_password):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect email or password",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    if not user.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Inactive user")

    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    access_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": str(user.id), "scopes": form_data.scopes},
        expires_delta=access_token_expires,
    )
    refresh_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    refresh_token = create_refresh_token(
        data={"sub": str(user.id)},
        expires_delta=refresh_token_expires,
    )

    # Store refresh token in DB with actual datetime
    expires_at = datetime.utcnow() + refresh_token_expires
    crud.create_refresh_token(db, user_id=user.id, token=refresh_token, expires_at=expires_at)

    return {
        "access_token": access_token,
        "refresh_token": refresh_token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
    }


@router.post("/refresh-token", response_model=schemas.Token, summary="Refresh access token")
@telemetry_log
async def refresh_access_token(
    refresh_token_str: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session)
) -> Any:
    """
    Refreshes an access token using a valid refresh token.
    The refresh token itself is returned unchanged if valid.

    - **refresh_token_str**: The refresh token obtained during login.
    """
    try:
        payload = verify_refresh_token(refresh_token_str)
        user_id = payload.get("sub")
        if not user_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid refresh token payload")
    except HTTPException as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid or expired refresh token") from e
    except Exception as e:
        # Catch other potential errors during token verification
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Error verifying refresh token") from e

    db_refresh_token = crud.get_refresh_token(db, user_id=user_id, token=refresh_token_str)

    if not db_refresh_token or db_refresh_token.is_revoked or db_refresh_token.expires_at < datetime.utcnow():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid or expired refresh token")

    user = crud.get_user(db, user_id=user_id)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="User not found")
    if not user.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Inactive user")

    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    # TODO: Get actual scopes from user roles or stored refresh token if applicable
    # For now, using a default scope for the new access token.
    new_access_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": str(user.id), "scopes": ["me"]},
        expires_delta=access_token_expires,
    )

    return {
        "access_token": new_access_token,
        "refresh_token": refresh_token_str,  # Return the same refresh token
        "token_type": "bearer",
    }


@router.post("/logout", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT, summary="Logout and revoke refresh token")
@telemetry_log
async def logout_user(
    refresh_token_str: str,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> Any:
    """
    Revokes a refresh token, effectively logging out the user from the current session.

    - **refresh_token_str**: The refresh token to be revoked.
    """
    db_refresh_token = crud.get_refresh_token(db, user_id=current_user.id, token=refresh_token_str)

    if not db_refresh_token:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Refresh token not found for this user.")

    if db_refresh_token.is_revoked:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Refresh token already revoked.")

    crud.revoke_refresh_token(db, db_refresh_token)
    return

    Can be filtered by category and minimum stock level.

    Requires:
    - Authentication (active user).
    - `skip`: Number of items to skip (for pagination).

    - `category`: Optional filter by item category.

    current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> Any:
    """
    Retrieves a single inventory item by its unique ID.

    Requires:
    - Authentication (active user).
    - `item_id`: The UUID of the inventory item to retrieve.
    """
    item = crud.get_inventory_item(db, item_id=item_id)
    if not item:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Inventory item not found")
    return item


@router.put("/inventory/{item_id}", response_model=schemas.InventoryItemRead, summary="Update an existing inventory item")
@telemetry_log
async def update_inventory_item(
    item_id: UUID,
    item_in: schemas.InventoryItemUpdate,
    current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db_session),
) -> Any:
    """
    Updates an existing inventory item. Only the owner of the item or an admin user can update it.

    Requires:
    - Authentication (active user).
    - `item_id`: The UUID of the inventory item to update.
    - `item_in`: Updated inventory item data.
    """
    item = crud.get_inventory_item(db, item_id=item_id)
    if not item:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Inventory item not found")
    
    # Authorization check: only owner or admin can update
    if item.created_by != current_user.id and not current_user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail="Not enough permissions to update this inventory item"
        )
    
    updated_item = crud.update_inventory_item(db, db_item=item, item_in=item_in)
    return updated_item

    item = crud.get_inventory_item(db, item_id=item_id)
    if not item:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Inventory item not found")
    crud.delete_inventory_item(db, item_id=item_id)
    return
